name: Mist's Edge
summary: North of Auberdine, Mist's Edge follows Darkshore's western shore under ocean fog. Gray beaches hold wrecks, the remains of great sea creatures, crabs, and murlocs.

sections.title: A Fog-Shrouded Shore
sections.body: Along Darkshore's western edge, Mist's Edge is a shore of damp sand and rocky tidepools beneath coastal fog. Shattered vessels and drift timber lie among the remains of huge sea creatures. Crabs forage along the beach, while murloc tribes make their homes in the surf.

sections.title: Wrecks and Scavengers
sections.body: Lost vessels leave wreckage and discarded cargo along these sands. Night elf sentinels and scavengers watch the coast. Yet murloc encampments menace travelers making their way along the shore from Auberdine.

faq.answer: North from Auberdine, Mist's Edge follows Darkshore's western shore beneath ocean fog, past shipwrecks and beached sea creatures.

aliases: what attacks you on the beach
faq.answer: Hostile crabs and aggressive murloc packs roam the shoreline. Murlocs live in primitive camps beside the water.

faq.q: Why are there so many shipwrecks and skeletons here?
faq.answer: Harsh currents, hidden reefs, and heavy mist make the waters off Darkshore dangerous to navigate, driving ships onto the rocks. Ocean currents also carry the remains of massive leviathans and other sea creatures ashore.

angles.text: For the night elves of Auberdine, Mist's Edge marks a maritime boundary and an untamed border troubled by invading murlocs and foul scavengers.
